authorship: Fixed synthetic evaluation dialogues authored by the experiment developer before prompt and image generation; separate from prior H1-H3, not external user data

turns.request: Dress the person in a dark navy blazer over an ivory crew-neck shirt.
Use a modern office background without plants, lamps or benches.
Attach one small circular silver pin to the viewer-right lapel.
Add one thin silver necklace with a small teardrop pendant.
Switch the office to a pale-blue studio and include one green potted plant.
Take off the pin entirely. Leave the necklace in place for now.
Take off the blazer and wear a plain light-gray crew-neck sweater instead.
Remove the necklace too. Keep the sweater and the latest background.

T2.focus: replace colors, shapes, position and background

turns.request: Use a forest-green blazer over an ivory crew-neck shirt.
Set the background to a library with wooden bookshelves and one warm floor lamp.
Place one small square gold pin on the viewer-right lapel.
Add one thin gold necklace with a small round gold pendant.
Change only the blazer to dark gray, keeping the ivory shirt.
Swap the gold pin for one small red triangular pin on the viewer-left lapel.
Remove the necklace and its pendant completely.
Replace the library and its lamp with an outdoor garden, a leafy hedge and one stone bench.

T3.focus: remove and re-add an item with different properties

turns.request: Start with a dark-gray blazer and an ivory crew-neck shirt.
Use a pale-blue studio background with one green potted plant.
Add one thin gold necklace with a small round gold pendant.
Add one small triangular red pin to the viewer-left lapel.
Remove the blazer and replace the ivory shirt with a plain white crew-neck shirt.
Remove the necklace and pendant; keep the red pin unchanged.
Put a beige blazer back on over the current white shirt.
Replace the red pin with one small square gold pin on the viewer-right lapel. Replace the studio and plant with a library and one warm floor lamp.

T4.focus: negated removal, subsequent cancellation and no background props

turns.request: Wear a dark navy blazer over a plain white crew-neck shirt.
Use an outdoor garden background with a leafy hedge and one stone bench.
Add one small circular blue pin to the viewer-left lapel.
Add one thin gold necklace with a small round gold pendant.
Do not remove the necklace. Remove only the lapel pin.
Make the blazer forest green and leave the white shirt as it is.
Replace the garden and bench with a studio having a plain red-brick wall and no plants, lamps or benches.
Now remove both the necklace and the blazer. Wear a plain dark-navy crew-neck sweater instead of the shirt.
